ConfigEvidence.description:
A value in a structured config file (JSON, TOML, YAML).

file's syntax: ``/project/dependencies/0`` in a pyproject.toml.
ConfigEvidence.title: ConfigEvidence

ConventionEvidence.description:
A naming or layout convention matched, e.g. ``test_*.py`` on a file name.

The convention's identity is ``provenance.rule`` (required); ``pattern`` is
its human-readable form, ``matched_value`` what it matched.
ConventionEvidence.title: ConventionEvidence

GroupEdgeView.description:

Producer.description:
An extractor or algorithm at a specific version and configuration.

Identity is ``(name, version, config_hash)``. Within one snapshot a producer
name appears at most once, so records refer to producers by ``name``.
Producer.title: Producer

Provenance.description:
Who asserted a claim, and by which rule.

``rule`` is what answers "why does this exist?". It is mandatory for
heuristic and inferred claims and for convention evidence (enforced by the
evidence and record models), and recommended everywhere else.
Provenance.title: Provenance

A stored edge touching the requested node, always in its stored direction

direction.description: `out`: the requested node is the source; `in`: it is the target.
direction.title: Direction
